p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and taxes on entry into the EU

p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: waybill (sea transport), air waybill (air transport), CMR (road transport)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (for reduced customs duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting companies)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer deals with everything at seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer's carrier, cleared for export.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on board the ship; after that, the risks and costs are borne by the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance to port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines.These lists are rejected and can be reported.
